metric: edge_apr_pct per window (fees less markout less cost, annualised, % of the pool's capital); weaker half = lower of the two 15-day halves
cost_model: pool price impact + fee tier + gas, engine.IMPACT=1
share_mode: mixed (legacy conservative), same as the gate

labels.set_and_forget: Set and forget (vault pool, vault width)

total_return.note: total return on the deposit in the half the gate reads (the vault's weaker half), annualised: the stock token deposited, fees plus the position's mark less the deposit, inventory drift included; hold is the token's price move with no position

set_and_forget.rule: vault pool, vault width, one range centred on the pool price at the window start, bounds snapped outward to the pool's tick spacing

manual_lp.rule: widest 30-day volume among hookless pools, +-10% centred on the pool price at the window start, bounds snapped outward to the pool's tick spacing

full_range_v3.rule: widest 30-day volume among v3 pools, full range from the window start
